name: [Partner Event] MLConf Seattle 2017 (register via Eventbrite)
venue.name: Art Marble 21
group.name: Seattle Data Science
description:
MLConf is coming back on May 19, and they have graciously offered a discount to the Seattle Data Science Meetup!


About the Event

MLconf was created to host the thought leaders in Machine Learning and AI to discuss their most recent experience with applying techniques, tools, algorithms and methodologies to the seemingly impossible problems that occur when dealing with massive and noisy data. MLconf is independent of any outside company or university – it’s simply a conference organized to gather the Machine Learning communities in various cities to share knowledge and create an environment for the community to coalesce.

name: Weekly Coding Club @ Galvanize
venue.name: Galvanize
group.name: Seattle Data Science
description:
*** Have trouble getting in? Email Lee at lee.ngo@galvanize.com ***

Every Tuesday night, come down to Galvanize for an always informal gathering of aspiring coders and data scientists, potential mentors, and just people looking for their developer community. This event is intentionally unstructured, though every so often there might be a special guest or fun activity, all driven by the community's interest. 

Possible Coding Club activities could include:

• Preparation for your coding exam or project

• Meeting a possible mentor in the community

• Roundtable conversations about code, education, and community

• Games of any kind (table top, computer, cards, etc.)

• Pair programming exercises

• Whatever you think we should do!

We may be deliberate with our activities at any given night, but you have the option to disengage as long

group.name: Mile Hi Power BI User Group
description:

Join us and Galvanize staff for a Data Science Immersive Info Session to learn more about our 12-week immersive data science training program in Seattle, Washington!

This program is for people who are serious about becoming data scientists. Over the course of 12 weeks, you'll learn the tools, techniques, and fundamental concepts you need to know to make an impact as a data scientist. You'll work through messy, real-world, data sets to gain experience across the data science stack: data munging, exploration, modeling, validation, visualization, and communication. Our unique setting in the Galvanize community of startups and tech companies is the perfect place to learn and expand your network!

group.name: Seattle Data Science
description:
*** Have trouble getting in? Email Lee at lee.ngo@galvanize.com ***

Every Tuesday night, come down to Galvanize for an always informal gathering of aspiring coders and data scientists, potential mentors, and just people looking for their developer community. This event is intentionally unstructured, though every so often there might be a special guest or fun activity, all driven by the community's interest. 

Possible Coding Club activities could include:

• Preparation for your coding exam or project

• Meeting a possible mentor in the community

• Roundtable conversations about code, education, and community

• Games of any kind (table top, computer, cards, etc.)

• Pair programming exercises

• Whatever you think we should do!

We may be deliberate with our activities at any given night, but you have the option to disengage as long

name: Galvanize Data Science Immersive Info Session (4.13)
venue.name: Galvanize
group.name: Seattle Data Science
description:
IMPORTANT: RSVP to this info session by clicking HERE. Meetup RSVP will not be counted.


Join us and Galvanize staff for a Data Science Immersive Info Session to learn more about our 12-week immersive data science training program in Seattle, Washington!

This program is for people who are serious about becoming data scientists. Over the course of 12 weeks, you'll learn the tools, techniques, and fundamental concepts you need to know to make an impact as a data scientist. You'll work through messy, real-world, data sets to gain experience across the data science stack: data munging, exploration, modeling, validation, visualization, and communication. Our unique setting in the Galvanize community of startups and tech companies is the perfect place to learn and expand your network!

Agenda

6:30 - 7:15 PM : Course Overview, Admissions Process,

description:
The availability of very low cost computers with general purpose I/O and running linux variants significantly lowers the ramp to writing programs that interface with the physical world, using very sophisticated and familiar software stacks. For example, a Raspberry Pi with built in wireless networking can be had for $10 - $40, depending on whether you need a single-core or quad-core processor, and supports popular platforms including, node, java, python and many great development tools and utilities.

In this talk, I will look at servos, pulse width modulation, and creation of a node module to enable servo control via node running on a Raspberry Pi. I will also briefly touch upon the use of the i2c module that is provided on npm. We’ll light some LEDs, spin some motors and, if time allows, also look at detecting and triggering other types of events via the GPIO pins on the pi.
